test_title: PYST 75: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The marksheets of many students have been __withheld__ by the university.
solution:
The correct answer is: **kept back**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **Kept back** can function as a synonym for **'withheld', **suggesting that the item in question is being held in possession and not released. (विचाराधीन वस्तु को कब्जे में रखा जा रहा है और जारी नहीं किया गया है)
 
• Thus, "*The marksheets of many students have been kept back __by the university*", would mean the same as the original sentence.
 
• Therefore, the most suitable replacement for **'withheld' **would be **'kept back'. **

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Gone through: **This phrase typically means to inspect or examine something in detail. (किसी चीज़ का विस्तार से निरीक्षण या परीक्षण करना)
 
• **Handed out: **This phrase means to distribute. (वितरित करने के लिए)
 
• **Given away: **To distribute or hand over to someone else. (बाँटना या किसी दूसरे को सौंपना)
